messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 - rapid kubelet restart wave in cluster infer-usw-1. Multiple nodes flapping -> Pod evictions and model server crashes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kubelet-flap
mike_oncall: I'm picking this up. Seeing kubelet restarts across a ~20m window and several model-server containers killed by OOM (exit 137). Pulling logs now. @sasha can you look at routing/steering? :pager:
sasha: On it. Looking at autoscaler and route weights. If this persists we should divert a chunk to eu-west canary and smaller models. Holding on config changes until we confirm cause.
mike_oncall: Snippet from node journal (trimmed):
```
Mar 17 12:48:09 node-usw-07 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 8821 (model-server) score 999
Mar 17 12:48:10 node-usw-07 kubelet[3012]: E kubelet: container "model-server" killed, exitCode=137
Mar 17 12:48:11 node-usw-07 nvidia: GPU X: GPU reset detected
Mar 17 12:48:12 node-usw-07 systemd: kubelet.service: main process exited, code=killed
```
kevin_runtime: Correlating: model variant rwd-llama-13b-quant-v2. NVidia driver reports resets then kernel OOMs. Logs show "CUDA out of memory" followed by host OOM killer. Likely memory pressure from model cache + too many concurrent heavy requests.
kevin_runtime: Immediate mitigation suggestion: 1) reduce concurrency on 13b models, 2) apply model fallback to rwd-llama-7b-quant for tail traffic, 3) set gpu_memory_cap to 0.75 on pool.
sasha: Preparing a routing override. Also will cordon the three worst nodes to stop noisy kubelets. Commands I'm running (internal ops):
```
kubectl cordon node-usw-07
kubectl drain node-usw-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
infra-bot: Autoscaler: request +2 nodes for infer-dedicated-usw pool (ETA ~3m). Taint applied -> NoSchedule for nodes: node-usw-07,node-usw-09. Evicting 94 pods.
anna_support: Support note - small set of US-West customers seeing elevated 5xx. Triage doc created and key accounts pinged. /cc @eng-sre
mike_oncall: Triage: currently ~1.8% error rate globally, concentrated on infer-usw-1 routings. Not customer-wide, no data exposure. Marking SEV2. Monitoring ETA for scale-up.
kevin_runtime: Routing override payload example (internal API):
POST /internal/route/override
{ "pool": "infer-usw-1", "weights": { "usw-13b": 0.60, "usw-7b": 0.25, "eu-west": 0.15 } }
kevin_runtime: Also flipping runtime config to throttle per-pod concurrency and enable CPU-fallback for long requests.
sasha: Pushed override: 15% -> eu-west canary, 25% -> 7b fallback. Autoscaler reporting nodes coming up. Uncordoning healthy nodes after validations.
infra-bot: New nodes provisioned: 2/2 ready. Kubelet checks initially failing on 1/2 but passed after boot scripts. Ongoing evictions: 12 pods.
kevin_runtime: After override, CUDA OOM logs dropped significantly on busy hosts. A handful of pods remain CrashLoopBackOff due to emptyDir eviction; will restart deployments once nodes stable.
mike_oncall: Customer impact update: error rate down to 0.4%, latency still slightly elevated for some requests. Holding monitoring window (20m) before clearing. Please delay outbound customer comms until we confirm stability. :eyes:
anna_support: Draft status ready: "Transient inference errors in US-West due to node restarts; traffic routed and mitigations in place, monitoring." Will send on final ok.
sasha: Uncordoned and drained nodes brought back; rollout of model-server restarted with conservative maxUnavailable=5%. Enabling KV prefix caching for hot endpoints.
kevin_runtime: Post-incident checklist: collect dmesg, nv-smi, kubelet logs, container logs; confirm driver pinned and machine image has kubelet memory reservation. Root cause hypothesis: memory headroom too low on AMI causing host OOM during heavy KV cache + model allocation.
mike_oncall: Action items logged: eng-runtime - default gpu_memory_cap for large models (kevin_runtime); infra - increase kubelet reserved memory in AMI (sasha); support - customer note after stability (anna_support). Tracking in incident board.
infra-bot: Cluster infer-usw-1: all nodes Ready. Evictions complete. Autoscaler idle.
mike_oncall: Monitoring window passed 25m with no further regressions. Closing SEV2. Thanks all. :tada:
